dedupe_keys.name: ebola west africa treatment centres isolation wards hospitals and transit centres 2014

description: This list records the Ebola treatment centres, isolation wards, hospitals and transit centres set up during the 2014 Ebola outbreak in West Africa. The producer is the British Red Cross Maps Team, which maintained it daily during the response and published it on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. Coverage is Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone and Nigeria between March and November 2014. Each row describes one facility, with its type and location as mapped by the team. The file is available as a free CSV download under a Creative Commons Attribution licence. Caveats: it is a frozen copy of a working list from the emergency, statuses and bed numbers changed quickly, and it records facilities as known to the Red Cross, not an official register; the column contents were not checked in detail for this record. Simulation uses: a historical example of how surge treatment capacity was built during an epidemic, calibrating the time and distance patients travelled to isolation, and planning temporary facilities in future outbreaks. Related records: the Chad and Nigeria facility lists (data-chad-health-facilities-moh, data-nigeria-health-facility-registry-extract) give permanent facilities in the region.
